verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents an official MCP server that lets AI assistants such as Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Windsurf control a browser, and a probe confirms the dedicated MCP docs page exists. The evidence is limited to that headline description, so the depth of the integration is not shown. Missing for 10: details on the exposed MCP tools and capabilities, setup/auth/transport documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working.
